title: License details: updates ended
summary: The same DJDL page for Kenji, whose yearly Studio license stopped renewing on Sep 30, 2026 and keeps the last version (licenses.list's 'Updates ended … keeps working' row): DJDL keeps working on 4.1.3, which fills Get it and the header's one solid action. The lapse is said once in each place it matters: the header pill, Get it's callout (your license covers 4.1.x, the latest of which is 4.1.3) and the License card's term block with the one Renew. The phone render emails the 4.1.3 download.
compare: Header: a warning pill 'Updates ended' beside the name, and the primary action downloads the last covered version ('Download 4.1.3', the page's only solid button), never a build the license doesn't cover. A keeps-the-last-version lapse is a warning, not 'Expired · danger' (that stays for stop licenses; PORTAL.md §5.3 needs the row).

Each fact once (owner, 2026-10-08): the header pill is the status; Get it's info callout says why the downloads are 4.1.3, '4.2.0 isn't in your license' / 'Your license covers versions in 4.1.x, the latest of which is 4.1.3.' (the owner's wording: the version line, not the cover date); the License card's term block says when and how it ended and holds the one Renew. No 'Not included' row for 4.2.0, no 'not in your license' on What's new, no 'your version' mark on 4.1.3: the callout already says each.

Get it: one downloads table of 4.1.3's files (Platform, SHA-256, Download): the Mac build is the tinted first row, 'For your Mac · .dmg · 82 MB', with an outlined Download, then Windows x64; each with a truncated SHA-256 and copy; the foot holds SHA256SUMS and no note.

Term block: 'Updates ended at 4.1.3' (LX-15's line 'Updates ended at 4.1.3 · keeps working'), 'Keeps working · renewal stopped Sep 30, 2026', the bar full from Sep 30, 2025 to Sep 30, 2026 and the 'Today, Oct 7' marker in the dashed accent stretch labelled 4.1.3; the track visible in both themes.

Under the chart, Renew with Example Audio as an outlined button with the external-link glyph (the developer's renew link, opens their site): the page's one Renew, in the card the route lands on. No paragraph restating the title and the callout.
A stop license (no keeps-the-last-version) never gets this copy: it shows 'Ended Sep 30, 2026' and 'Renew with Example Audio to keep using it'.

Facts: License source 'From Example Audio' (issued by hand), Works offline for 30 days, Release track Stable, License key 'None, sign in instead'. No Activated fact: the bar starts at the last renewal, and a second, older date beside it would read as a conflict. No 'Covers versions' fact: the term title says it.

Included keeps the tier's entitlements on one line (Stem separation · 4 decks · Recording · Cloud Sync; the 1 GB is said once, in Cloud Sync's usage): keeps-the-last-version keeps entitlements, only newer versions stop.
What's new keeps 4.2.0's notes with no subtitle; Earlier versions is a compact table (4.1.3 Sep 22, 2026; 4.1.2 Sep 9, 2026).

Devices shows two devices on 4.1.3 with no warning: a lapsed keeps-the-last-version license is not an error on a device. The head carries '2 of 10 in use' as a bar (ten devices draw as a bar, not ten segments). Remove and Delete synced data confirm as on portal.license.

Phone renders stand for a phone user agent (PORTAL.md §5.4, 'Expired, an older build is covered'): the pill beside the name, then 'Email me the download' (solid, full width) and the overflow, with the line 'We'll email kenji@example.com a link to 4.1.3 for your Mac or PC.' under them; no tinted row, no 'this device'.

Sizes as portal.license: three columns from 1280 px, two under the jump bar at tablet, one column below 1024 px in the jump bar's order. Phone: the jump bar scrolls sideways with a faded edge, License marked; Cloud Sync's buttons wrap; the footer sits above the bottom bar, whose Activate is the outlined pill.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Needs fixes, now applied: one solid button, the downloadable 4.1.3 builds grouped first with 4.2.0 as one quiet row, the phone emails the download, and the lapse is said once at the top and once in full.

findings.issue: Three solid violet buttons (header Download 4.1.3, recommended Download, Renew) with no clear main action.
findings.resolution: Header 'Download 4.1.3' is the only solid button; the recommended Download is outlined; Renew with Example Audio is an outlined button with the external-link glyph, and is also the link in the '4.2.0 isn't in your license' callout.

findings.issue: All platforms mixed 4.2.0 Not included rows with 4.1.3 downloads; bold 'Not included' was the strongest text; rows you can't download kept a SHA-256 and copy.
findings.resolution: Grouped: 'Your version, 4.1.3' with its macOS and Windows rows, then one quiet row '4.2.0 for macOS and Windows · Released after your updates ended · Not included' in muted regular weight (the kit draws Rubik at 400 and 700 only, so no medium weight), with no SHA-256, copy or download. The row has no second Renew: the callout at the top of the same card carries it (density finding).

findings.issue: Phone header was the pill plus a solid 'Download 4.1.3'; PORTAL.md §5.4 gives 'Email me the download'.
findings.resolution: Phone: the pill on its own line, then 'Email me the download' (solid, full width, §5.4's words; the email names 4.1.3) and the overflow; the recommended card becomes the callout 'We'll email kenji@example.com a link to 4.1.3 that opens on your Mac or PC.'; no 'this device'.

findings.issue: The '4.2.0 isn't in your license' callout had no action; the only Renew was about 1,400 px further down on phone.
findings.resolution: 'Renew with Example Audio ↗' is the callout's link, under its text rather than in the trailing slot, which would squeeze the text into a narrow column on phone.

findings.issue: The lapse was said about nine times, reading as alarm.
findings.resolution: Said once at the top (pill, callout with Renew) and once in full (duration block). Dropped the 'Covers versions' fact (Release track takes its place), the holder box's 'and install 4.1.3' and the two 'Released after your updates ended' rows (one quiet row now); 'yours to keep' became 'your version'; What's new keeps 'not in your license'.

findings.issue: The bar's left end read 'Sep 30, 2025' while Activated said Sep 30, 2024.
Versus house doc: the warning 'Updates ended' pill is better than PORTAL.md §5.3's 'Expired · danger'.
findings.resolution: No mockup change. The PORTAL.md §5.3 update (an 'Updates ended · warning' row for keeps-the-last-version licenses, quick action Download <last covered version>; 'Expired · danger' only for stop licenses) is noted for the lead: PORTAL.md is outside the mockups directory.
